-- EP-488 v51 / G5 (resubmit): Degree-3 is strict local minimum
-- Shows each potential smaller neighbor (2a/3, 3a/4, 3a/5, 4a/5) is below q/2
-- when a < 3q/5.

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-- If a < 3q/5, then 2*(2a/3) < q (i.e. 2a/3 < q/2). -/
theorem smaller_2a_3_below_q_2
    {q a : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : 5 * a < 3 * q)
    (hdiv : 3 ∣ a) :
    2 * (2 * a / 3) < q := by
  sorry

/-- If a < 3q/5, then 2*(3a/4) < q. -/
theorem smaller_3a_4_below_q_2
    {q a : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : 5 * a < 3 * q)
    (hdiv : 4 ∣ a) :
    2 * (3 * a / 4) < q := by
  sorry

/-- If a < 3q/5, then 2*(4a/5) < q. -/
theorem smaller_4a_5_below_q_2
    {q a : ℕ}
    (hq : 0 < q)
    (ha : 5 * a < 3 * q)
    (hdiv : 5 ∣ a) :
    2 * (4 * a / 5) < q := by
  sorry
